reviewer: C direct review; not external independent judge

axes.meaning: Preserve actor, recipient/target/scope, action, certainty/completion, negation, conditions, dates and quantities; presence of a few keywords is insufficient.
axes.instruction: Perform only the requested transformation; preserve every non-target fact and condition, including across turns.
axes.unsupported_additions: No invented facts, confirmations, deadlines, actions or new requests. Conventional courtesy is not itself a factual invention.
axes.naturalness: Usable Korean for the requested format; avoid awkward self-identification, dangling sentence endings and redundant explanation.
axes.context: Resolve prior-turn references without discarding qualifiers required in the rewritten standalone text.

decision_rule: All substantive facts/constraints and the requested transformation must hold; naturalness is reviewed separately. Never use exact-string agreement with Astra as the sole pass rule. A reference with a style defect is held, not used as a polished target.

case_reviews.note: D03 원문은 '다음 사실' 뒤에 부정 설명도 포함한다. 이를 포함했다는 이유만으로 근거 없는 추가나 의미 오류로 판정하지 않는다. 접수 완료 보존·가능 여부 질문으로 변경하지 않기·요청 형식·자연스러움을 판단하며 Astra 문장과의 동일성을 요구하지 않는다.
Explicit self-identification is awkward; revise before treating as a polished training target.
Place marker is faithful but the sentence ending is telegraphic; polish before training.

observed_candidate_gap.verdict: Partial source fidelity for standalone rewrite; do not promote to full quality pass.
